B0CQS4SS9F.title: Z-Wave Smart Plug, 800 Series Z-Wave Outlet with Built-in Repeater
bullets: [Long Range That Reaches Your Whole Home] Powered by the latest 800 Series Z-Wave chip, this smart outlet extends data transmission up to 1,300 ft in open areas — strong enough to reach your detached garage, basement, or backyard shed

[S2 Security] Each Z-Wave plug comes with a unique DSK QR code for secure pairing. S2 encryption protects your smart home network by blocking unauthorized access and replay attacks — giving you peace of mind when automating lights, locks, or garage doors. No more worrying about "can someone hack my smart plug?"

[Hub Compatibility] This Z-Wave smart plug requires a hub and is compatible with SmartThings, Hubitat, Vera, Wink, Fibaro, HomeSeer, 2GIG, and most Z-Wave controllers. Note: Does NOT work with Echo Plus or Vivint Hub. Confirm your hub supports Z-Wave before purchasing.

[Z-Wave Repeater] Every New One Z-Wave plug doubles as a signal repeater, automatically boosting your mesh network to eliminate dead zones. It relays signals up to 4 layers deep — ideal for multi-story homes or setups where your hub is far from the device you want to control.

[Compact Design] Slim profile lets you plug two units side by side in a standard duplex outlet without blocking the second socket. Supports appliances up to 1875W — enough for space heaters, coffee makers, and window AC units. Control yours remotely via the app: "Alexa, turn on the coffee machine."
